asset-dogger-bank-wind.name: Dogger Bank Wind Farm — North Sea

book_concentration.rationale: World's largest offshore wind complex at 3.6 GW across three 1.2 GW phases concentrates generation value in one North Sea development area.

non_firm_intensity.rationale: Each phase holds a secured 1 GW transmission connection but is overplanted to 1.2 GW, creating routine export curtailment rather than queue non-firmness.

aggregation_correlation.rationale: Derived aggregation_correlation (l3_single_boundary): asset on unknown boundary; HHI=1.0000 over 1 boundary zone(s) → rating 4.

trigger_gap.rationale: No evidence of curtailment or availability parametric cover; typical renewable damage-only property protection assumed.

tenor_mismatch.rationale: Up to 35-year operational life and 15-year CfDs against a short history of HVDC export and overplanting curtailment dynamics.

data_monitoring.rationale: Utility-scale offshore SCADA with HVDC telemetry and active Balancing Mechanism participation as a major North Sea generator.

product_fit.rationale: No evidence of curtailment or parametric insurance cover at asset level.

underwriting_expertise.rationale: Generation asset without dedicated insurance underwriting capability.

capital_reinsurance.rationale: Backed by SSE, Equinor and Vårgrønn with record-scale project financing on all three phases.

pricing_modelling.rationale: Generation asset, not an insurance pricing entity.

asset_link.connection: National Grid HVDC — Creyke Beck (A/B) and Lackenby (C); 1 GW secured per phase, overplanted to 1.2 GW

asset-dogger-bank-wind.notes: 3.6 GW (3×1.2 GW phases A/B/C) 130–200 km off Yorkshire; HVDC export to Creyke Beck (A/B) and Lackenby (C); first UK offshore HVDC wind link; overplanted to 1.2 GW against 1 GW connections.

asset-hornsea-wind-farm.name: Hornsea Wind Farm — North Sea

book_concentration.rationale: Operational Hornsea One (1.2 GW) and Hornsea Two (1.3 GW) concentrate ~2.5 GW of offshore generation in one Yorkshire Round 3 zone.

non_firm_intensity.rationale: Operational firm connections but documented Balancing Mechanism constraint payments since 2019 as east-coast transmission limits tighten.

aggregation_correlation.rationale: Derived aggregation_correlation (l3_single_boundary): asset on unknown boundary; HHI=1.0000 over 1 boundary zone(s) → rating 4.

trigger_gap.rationale: Constraint compensation via Balancing Mechanism is not availability/parametric cover against revenue loss from curtailment.

tenor_mismatch.rationale: Multi-decade CfD-backed assets against a worsening constraint-payment regime as more North Sea wind connects.

data_monitoring.rationale: Full offshore SCADA and documented Balancing Mechanism constraint dispatch on Hornsea One since commissioning.

product_fit.rationale: No evidence of curtailment or parametric insurance cover at asset level.

underwriting_expertise.rationale: Generation asset without dedicated insurance underwriting capability.

capital_reinsurance.rationale: Operated by Ørsted, a large listed utility with institutional co-investors on Hornsea One and Two.

pricing_modelling.rationale: Generation asset, not an insurance pricing entity.

asset_link.mw: 2500 MW (Hornsea One 1200 MW + Hornsea Two 1300 MW operational)
asset_link.connection: National Grid east-coast corridor — Hornsea Two via Killingholme 400 kV

asset-hornsea-wind-farm.notes: Hornsea One 1.2 GW + Hornsea Two 1.3 GW operational off Yorkshire (~120 km); Hornsea Two connected at National Grid Killingholme; documented constraint payments since 2019; Hornsea 3/4 in development/discontinued.

asset-east-anglia-offshore-wind.name: East Anglia Offshore Wind — North Sea

book_concentration.rationale: East Anglia Hub clusters over 3.9 GW across four projects (ONE operational, TWO/THREE/ONE North building) in one southern North Sea zone.

non_firm_intensity.rationale: East Anglia ONE is operational on firm connection but hub expansion to 3.9+ GW will face EC5 export constraints before Norwich–Tilbury and Sea Link complete.

aggregation_correlation.rationale: Derived aggregation_correlation (l3_single_boundary): asset on unknown boundary; HHI=1.0000 over 1 boundary zone(s) → rating 4.

trigger_gap.rationale: No evidence of curtailment or availability parametric cover; assumed damage-only renewable property protection.

tenor_mismatch.rationale: GBP 10 bn multi-phase hub with 30+ year asset life against emerging East Anglia export constraints and delayed critical reinforcements post-2030.

data_monitoring.rationale: Operational East Anglia ONE runs full offshore SCADA with dedicated O&M base at Lowestoft for fleet telemetry.

product_fit.rationale: No evidence of curtailment or parametric insurance cover at asset level.

underwriting_expertise.rationale: Generation asset without dedicated insurance underwriting capability.

capital_reinsurance.rationale: Developed by Iberdrola/ScottishPower Renewables with GBP 10 bn hub financing and institutional partners on East Anglia ONE.

pricing_modelling.rationale: Generation asset, not an insurance pricing entity.

asset_link.mw: 714 MW operational (East Anglia ONE); hub to ~3900 MW (TWO/THREE/ONE North)
asset_link.connection: National Grid Bramford 400 kV — EC5 export boundary pending Norwich–Tilbury reinforcement

asset-east-anglia-offshore-wind.notes: East Anglia ONE 714 MW operational (102×7 MW, 43 km off Suffolk); exports via Burstall to National Grid Bramford 400 kV; Hub adds ~3.25 GW (TWO/THREE/ONE North) by 2026; EC5 export constraint risk.

asset-keadby-gas-peaker.name: Keadby Gas Peaker — North Lincolnshire

book_concentration.rationale: Flexible generation concentrated at the single Keadby site with Keadby 1 (732 MW) and Keadby 2 (893 MW) sharing one 400 kV National Grid connection area.

non_firm_intensity.rationale: Commercially operational CCGT with secured 893 MW transmission entry on Keadby 2 and 15-year Capacity Market contract; flexible dispatch is the asset function, not queue non-firmness.

aggregation_correlation.rationale: Derived aggregation_correlation (l3_single_boundary): asset on unknown boundary; HHI=1.0000 over 1 boundary zone(s) → rating 4.

trigger_gap.rationale: No evidence of availability or parametric cover for merchant/Capacity Market revenue volatility.

tenor_mismatch.rationale: 15-year Capacity Market contract on Keadby 2 offsets long asset life against shorter observed flexible-generation revenue history.

data_monitoring.rationale: Modern CCGT with Siemens Energy 9000HL turbine, 30-minute ramp to full load and active grid balancing dispatch.

product_fit.rationale: No insurance cover known, but the asset itself is flexible backup generation complementing variable renewables.

underwriting_expertise.rationale: Generation asset without dedicated insurance underwriting capability.

capital_reinsurance.rationale: Owned by SSE Thermal, part of FTSE-listed SSE plc with GBP 350m Keadby 2 investment.

pricing_modelling.rationale: Generation asset, not an insurance pricing entity.

asset_link.connection: National Grid 400 kV — single Keadby connection area, North Lincolnshire

asset-keadby-gas-peaker.notes: Keadby flexible gas site: Keadby 1 732 MW (1996) + Keadby 2 893 MW CCGT (commercial March 2022); 63% efficiency, 30-min ramp, 804 MW de-rated Capacity Market 2020; 400 kV National Grid connection, North Lincolnshire Humber cluster.

asset-cottam-solar-bess.name: Cottam Solar + BESS — Nottinghamshire
asset-cottam-solar-bess.parent_group: Island Green Power (Cottam Solar Project Ltd)

book_concentration.rationale: Up to 600 MW solar plus 600 MW BESS across four parcels converges on a single 400 kV point of connection at the former Cottam coal substation.

non_firm_intensity.rationale: 600 MW connection offer at former Cottam substation but no public Gate 1/2 firmness confirmation under NESO's reformed connections regime; pre-build greenfield.

aggregation_correlation.rationale: Derived aggregation_correlation (l3_single_boundary): asset on unknown boundary; HHI=1.0000 over 1 boundary zone(s) → rating 4.

trigger_gap.rationale: Pre-build greenfield with no evidence of availability or parametric cover for connection delay or curtailment risk.

tenor_mismatch.rationale: 40-year NSIP asset horizon against evolving NESO connection reform and no operational curtailment history.

data_monitoring.rationale: Not yet operational; no live SCADA or market telemetry in place.

product_fit.rationale: Co-located 600 MW BESS planned for grid balancing but no insurance product cover evidenced.

underwriting_expertise.rationale: Development SPV without insurance underwriting capability.

capital_reinsurance.rationale: Backed by Island Green Power with Macquarie Asset Management stake and Shell New Energies share charge on the project company.

pricing_modelling.rationale: Development asset, not an insurance pricing entity.

asset_link.connection: National Grid former Cottam Power Station 400 kV POC — DCO granted Sep 2024, pre-build

asset-cottam-solar-bess.notes: 600 MW solar + 600 MW BESS NSIP (EN010133); DCO granted 5 Sep 2024; former Cottam Power Station 400 kV POC, Nottinghamshire/Lincolnshire; pre-build, construction from 2025; Island Green Power developer.

asset-moray-west-offshore-wind.name: Moray West Offshore Wind — Scotland

trigger_gap.rationale: Constraint Balancing Mechanism payments are not availability or parametric cover against revenue loss.

tenor_mismatch.rationale: Multi-decade CfD-backed asset against rapidly worsening Scottish boundary curtailment (B4 constrained 42% of hours in 2025).

data_monitoring.rationale: Full offshore SCADA with documented high-volume Balancing Mechanism constraint dispatch in 2025.

product_fit.rationale: No evidence of curtailment or parametric insurance cover at asset level.

underwriting_expertise.rationale: Generation asset without dedicated insurance underwriting capability.

capital_reinsurance.rationale: Developed by Ocean Winds, a major offshore JV of EDP Renewables and ENGIE with GBP 800m+ Scottish economic commitment.

pricing_modelling.rationale: Generation asset, not an insurance pricing entity.

asset_link.connection: SSEN Transmission Moray Firth export — B4 north-Scotland constraint boundary

asset-moray-west-offshore-wind.notes: 882 MW (60×14.7 MW SG 14-222 DD) Moray Firth; fully operational 2025; 1.4 TWh curtailed in 2025 (3rd highest GB asset); behind B4/B6 boundaries with Moray East; O&M Buckie.
